title: Artificial Intelligence and Acute Stroke Imaging

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Artificial Intelligence and Acute Stroke Imaging》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】The purpose of this review is twofold: first, to describe AI methods and available public and commercial platforms in stroke imaging, and second, to summarize the literature of current artificial intelligence-driven applications for acute stroke triage, surveillance, and prediction.
